_comment: The formation compresses in a confined space (the game designer's decision 2026-11-21: 'the whole squad must enter' a ~5 m2 khrushchevka flat hall and the 2.5 m gable-vestibule corridors). Read by FormationConfinedTuning (C++, Source/CodexTactics/Public/Formation/FormationConfinedRules.h - the full rule). When the leader arrives (his destination within arrive_m, within level_dz_cm of his floor) or stands, probe_rays navmesh rays of probe_m round the destination measure the pocket; it is confined when their median free distance <= confined_median_m (open ground never is - the formation there is unchanged; in a confined pocket the automatic wall layout is skipped). A follower's slot outside the pocket (radius max(median, min_radius_cm), wall_margin_cm short of the free distance), on the leader's remaining way or on the entry line (way_half_width_cm round them) moves to a place inside it on the probe rays (rings from min_spacing_cm in ring_step_cm steps and 2 x min_spacing_cm), min_spacing_cm from the leader and each other, reached on a straight line keeping pass_clear_cm from the places given out, never past the leader in a hall narrower than 2 x pass_free_cm; cost = his walk - depth_weight x the distance from the entry point (the first man in goes deepest); walking to his place a follower faces his walk until face_walk_cm from it. While compressed the followers' crowd separation and obstacle avoidance are off (Codex.Formation.ConfinedCrowd 1 keeps them). recenter_cm / refresh_s: a held pocket is probed again. Console Codex.Formation.Confined -1 = this file, 0 = off (A/B), 1 = on.
